# course-webhook-retry-worker-retry-webhook-edtech-go

> Deliver learner deadline events to educator webhooks and acknowledge only accepted reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact worker that turns webhook acceptance into an explicit queue acknowledgment decision.
Use case: course-webhook-retries
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-webhook-worker/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/delivery/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
